findings.message: Constant "API_V2_URL" is file-local and should be camelCase ("apiV2Url"). `const` already tells the reader and the compiler the value is immutable, so shouting adds no information. The casing is free to signal scope instead, the way Go does it: PascalCase means the value came from somewhere else, camelCase means it lives in this file. Reserve the shouting form for values that mirror an external system's grammar, where matching the upstream spelling keeps the value greppable across a boundary you do not control.
